entry.title: Teaching at EMBL - Integrative analysis of multi-omics data

link.title: Teaching at EMBL - Integrative analysis of multi-omics data

entry.content:
Francisca, Jana, Jan and Wangjun contributed as speakers and trainers at the EMBO Practical Course on Integrative Analysis of Multi-Omics Data at EMBL Heidelberg. They shared our expertise on Probabilistic Factor Models for Multi-Omics Data Integration.

You can read more about this EMBO Course on the EMBL website.

entry.title: Team Hackaton
entry.content:
Some teams fuel their hackathons with energy drinks. We started ours with pretzels and banana bread — because if you are going to spend a whole day rethinking how you work, you should at least do it well fed. Everyone shared their workflows, their favourite solutions, but also their pain points: nothing is quite as honest as a room full of colleagues describing the tasks that make them sigh.

And part of the hackathon output? The very blog you are reading right now, and more still to come…
